name: cueroom
description: Open-source, non-affiliated co-watch companion with video calls, chat, and Netflix playback sync.

scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm --filter @cueroom/shared build && pnpm --filter @cueroom/security build && pnpm --filter @cueroom/ui build
scripts.verify: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security:extension && pnpm cleanup:check && pnpm docs:freshness
